statement: Voice queries (POST /api/bot/voice-query) are available on Pro and Premium plans only.
Natural language text queries (POST /api/query) are available on Pro and Premium plans only.
The personal knowledge base (/api/kb) is available on Pro and Premium plans only.
Full client data export (CSV, structured notes JSON) is available on Pro and Premium plans. Trial and Basic receive diary-only JSON export.
Analytics data export (CSV or PDF report) is available on the Premium plan only.
Client seat limits are enforced per plan tier: Trial 3 seats, Basic 10, Pro 30, Premium unlimited.
